requirement.evidence: B. It shall be unlawful for a landlord to use a coordinated pricing algorithm described in subsection A when setting rents or occupancy levels for residential dwelling units in the city of Berkeley.
requirement.note: Sale ban in 13.63.030.A and tenant remedies in 13.63.040.B (injunctive relief, money damages, civil penalties up to $1,000, attorney's fees) also stated.

key_value.evidence: Each separate month that a violation exists or continues, and each separate residential dwelling unit for which the landlord used the coordinated pricing algorithm, shall constitute a separate and distinct violation.
key_value.note: The $1,000 per violation cap is in 13.63.040: "civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation."

effective_date.evidence: The provisions of this Chapter shall not take effect until March 1, 2026.

status.evidence: The provisions of this Chapter shall not take effect until March 1, 2026.
status.note: As of 2026-10-01 the effective date has passed, so in_force follows. The document was retrieved 2026-10-03 and presents the rule as current law.
